description: 克隆 MiniOneRec 仓库、配置环境、使用 OpenJev 对 MIND 进行 noul 决策评分与 AUC 评估

commands.name: 删除旧的 MiniOneRec 目录
启动 OpenJev 评估
commands.description: 使用 OpenJev 作为 noul 决策模型对每个(candidate)评分并计算 AUC
commands.command: EVAL_OUTPUT_DIR=$(dirname {model_path})/jev_eval_results && mkdir -p $EVAL_OUTPUT_DIR && echo '=== OpenJev model path:' {model_path} '===' && ls -la {model_path} | head -20 && if [ "{use_abstract}" = "1" ]; then ABS_FLAG="--use_abstract"; else ABS_FLAG=""; fi && CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 HF_DATASETS_OFFLINE=1 DATA_ROOT={data_root} /home/aiscuser/.conda/envs/MiniOneRec/bin/python -u src/evaluate_mind_jev.py --model_path {model_path} --behaviors_path {data_root}/{split}/behaviors.tsv --news_path {data_root}/{split}/news.tsv --max_history {max_history} --max_impressions {max_impressions} $ABS_FLAG --output_file $EVAL_OUTPUT_DIR/{split}_jev_predictions.txt && echo '=== Results ===' && head -2 $EVAL_OUTPUT_DIR/{split}_jev_predictions.txt && echo 'Evaluation results saved to' $EVAL_OUTPUT_DIR/

commands.name: 调试模式-保持容器运行
commands.command: echo '=== 调试模式: 容器将保持运行 ===' && sleep infinity
